priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the cleanup callback
findings.body: The returned function no longer unregisters the message handler. Consumers that invoke it during teardown will remain subscribed, allowing callbacks after disposal and accumulating duplicate listeners or retained resources across repeated attach-and-cleanup cycles.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 1e0da198c309110ef71746055391c5edd2d1e94c, src/socket.ts:2 still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed cleanup at line 3 remains `return () => {};`; the full diff shows this PR removed the previous matching socket.off call.
